customManagers.description: hk.pkl names hk's version in its package URLs and min_hk_version, which no manager reads, so bump them from hk's releases

packageRules.description: mise writes and verifies the package files under mise/locks/ when it installs npm tools, so leave them to it. A package rule rather than ignorePaths, which would replace the presets' paths
Lock file maintenance and pins change no version ranges, so merge them once CI passes
Digests track a moving tag or branch, so take them sooner
Workflow and action updates only affect CI
Mise tools only affect the build, so updating them must not cut a release
hk from mise and its hk.pkl packages must move together, or hk runs against a config for another version. Both only affect the build
Python build backends only affect how the package is built, so must not cut a release
Raising requires-python changes who can install the package, so cut a release
New versions of this preset are my own changes, so take them straight away. They only change dependency config, so must not cut a release
Astral's releases are trusted, so automerge their tools' minor and patch updates from mise even before 1.0
The oxc project's releases are trusted, so automerge their tools' minor and patch updates from mise even before 1.0
rumdl's releases are trusted, so automerge their tools' minor and patch updates from mise even before 1.0
